description.text: Starter Set MEGA Mega Gengar ex, released on 5 September 2025 with Mega Diancie ex's, the first ready-built decks of Mega Evolution Pokémon ex: a ready-to-play 60-card deck with two Mega Gengar ex. Its Shadowy Concealment makes the opponent take one fewer Prize card when one of your Darkness Pokémon is Knocked Out by a Pokémon ex's attack, and its Void Gale does 230 damage and moves an Energy from it to the Bench. Honchkrow, Sableye and the new Punk Helmet back it up, with the ACE SPEC Prime Catcher, and a full-illustration Haunter explores a forest at night. Damage counters and markers, a coin, a playmat, a player's guide and a how-to-play booklet came with it.
